updates.text: Added daily posting capability, enabling the bot to generate and publish LinkedIn and X posts automatically each day.
Implemented a flagship dispatch app that integrated PartyRock SOS calls, automated mission loading, and linked SOS orders to the fleet dashboard.
Implemented a free‑boundary equilibrium Picard solver, added FreeGS reference equilibrium for TCV, and introduced inverse shape solve for coil currents.
Started shafranov: a real‑time C++20 simulator solving the Grad–Shafranov equation for TCV, evolving coil, vessel and plasma currents to capture vertical instability.
Added three daily post options—work, news, meme—support for private repos, and scheduled daily posts at 9 am Malaysia time with a backup at 10:15 MYT.
Added a fast fixed‑boundary Grad‑Shafranov solver, TCV vacuum vessel with 256 filaments, and poloidal field coils to the real‑time C++20 simulator.
Implemented health monitoring, predictive maintenance models, and an operator dashboard with weather, storm detour, and fleet map features.
Tick the market every 10 minutes from GitHub Actions.
